name: Arboleda Category List for Elementor
author: fabio arboleda

sections.description:
Arboleda Category List for Elementor adds a fully customizable WooCommerce category listing block to the Elementor editor. This is an independent, third-party plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor or WooCommerce.

Layouts:
* Grid, List, Masonry, Carousel

Category Configuration:
* Order by name, count, menu order, ID or slug
* Show only parent categories
* Hide/show empty categories
* Exclude categories by ID
* Number of categories to display

Display Options:
* Category image with size and position (top, background, left, right)
* Title with configurable HTML tag (H1–H6)
* Product count with custom label text
* Description with word-count truncation
* Call-to-action button with custom text
* Subcategories as pill tags
* 5 hover effects: Lift, Zoom, Overlay, Slide, None

Style Controls:
* Card: background, padding, border, radius, shadow (normal + hover)
* Image: height, border-radius, object-fit, overlay color
* Typography: font, size, color, alignment (title / count / description)
* Button: color, background, border, padding, radius, typography (normal + hover)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the arboleda-category-list-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Ensure Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and active
  4. Open Elementor editor and search for “Categorías WooCommerce” in the widget panel
  5. Drag the widget onto your page
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No, it works with the free version of Elementor.

Is this an official Elementor or WooCommerce plugin?

No. This is an independent third-party plugin and has no affiliation with Elementor or WooCommerce.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. All styles are self-contained and do not depend on the active theme.
